svg.aria-label: Pricing: same items, two shops. The agency rings up a $4,500 audit plus $8,500 a month, the calendar flips through year one and the receipt piles up to $106,500, while the crew fills a cart at the claude-seo stall for 0 coins. The shopkeeper faints: saved $106,500.
